activation_base_rule: exact current integration head containing every dependency APPROVED and integrated
activation_steps: Verify T12 APPROVED in dependency graph, registry and task gates.
Verify dependency ownership closed out and interfaces reconciled.
Verify T12_CONSUMER_BINDING matches the current T12 downstream consumer contract.
Verify current GAME_MASTER_POLICY required proof flags are exact.
Re-check planned paths against integration-only and active ownership.
Refresh current contract hashes and generated task packet.
Create/rebase havenline/T13-challenge-director from exact post-activation head.
Require candidate guard PASS before runtime/data expands.
claim_template: python3 tools/havenline/production/workstream.py claim T13 --owner challenge-director-builder --branch havenline/T13-challenge-director --base <EXACT_CURRENT_INTEGRATION_HEAD> --owned-alias @reservation:T13 --status ASSIGNED
